name: Lab monitor - eye tracker, 24-2 without top/bottom rows
description: Eye tracker (Tobii Pro Fusion, 50-80 cm): 24-2 positions without the +/-21 deg rows and the 2 nasal points, 42 spots, at 52 cm with a chin rest. Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Start python/specvis.sh tracker-bridge first. Screen: BenQ 24.5", 544 mm wide (picture area as the monitor reports it). Choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen". For comparing grids, run the "Aflah grid" eye-tracker preset on the same person.
